corrections_found_during_implementation: tool_api.strict_json keeps the last duplicate key; both modules now refuse duplicate keys explicitly.
apply_capture_profile source_bytes corrected from unknown to enforced 3 GiB (worker hashes source under capture.MAX_SOURCE_BYTES).
Hash loop now fails changed_during_hash as soon as a file grows beyond its pre-open size (an appending writer previously kept the read going until max_bytes).
Index document serialization bug (wrong comprehension key) caught by the dump/load round-trip test before commit.
declared_not_verified: Resource classes, heavy_numeric, effects reads/writes, provenance fields marked declared_unverified.

source_bytes enforced values are read from worker constants (capture_profile/apply_capture_profile/share_export 3 GiB, editor_marker_plan 20000000 per JSON, annotation_v2 20000 request); not exercised by tests here.
deviations_from_frozen_contract: dump uses fsync + hard-link (atomic, no-clobber) instead of temp + replace, so a concurrently created target is never overwritten.
Additional refusals beyond the contract minimum: PE "MZ" magic (executable_refused), non-ASCII components (unsafe_component), selectors whose first component is "artifacts" (outside_runs_root).
resolve: an exec bit gained after projection raises executable_refused; a directory or FIFO now at the selector resolves missing.
Accepted run bytes were ~608 MB, not the ~180 MB estimate; one 300 s bounded job completed in about 20 s.
measured: Closed-schema validation of program/capabilities.json against program/tools.json (8 tools, 48 parameters).
Refusal codes, stale/missing/current states and idempotency on synthetic fixtures.
SHA-256 projection of the accepted FULLER run (607516852 bytes, 12 files) with unchanged tree hash.
